sentences.text:
Appearance:
 Shri Akhilesh Kumar Saxena - advocate for the petitione
 Shri Tarun Pagare appearing on behalf of Advocate Gener
 Order
Heard and perused the record.
2.  This is the second bail application filed on behalf of the applicant under Section 439 of CR.P.C. for grant of bail.

The applicant is arrested in relation to Crime No.532/2023, dated (not mentioned),
registered at Police Station-Chandan Nagar District-Indore for the offence under Section 363, 376,
376(2)(n) of IPC and under Section 5(L)/6 and 3/4of POCSO Act.
The applicant is in jail since 24.052024.
Earlier, first bail application of the applicant was dismissed as withdrawn with liberty to renew the prayer after two months.
3. Allegation against the applicant is that he he has committed rape upon the prosecutrix.
4. Learned counsel for the applicants submits that the applicant is innocent and has falsely been implicated in this case.

It is further submitted that first bail application of the applicant was dismissed as withdrawn with liberty to renew the prayer after two months and now, the said period of liberty has been completed.

The allegation against the applicant is only that he has taken the prosecutrix on his vehicle and handed her NEUTRAL CITATION NO. 2024:MPHC-IND:32078 2 MCRC-47815-2024 over to his brother-in-law who has committed rape upon her.
As per the statement of the prosecutrix, she remained with the applicant for 03 months and their relations were consensual.
The applicant is in jail since 24.05.2024.
Conclusion of trial will take sufficient long time.
Under these circumstances, counsel prays for grant of bail to the applicant.

sentences.text: On the other hand, learned Govt. Advocate for the State has opposed the prayer.
6. After hearing learned counsel for the parties and custody period of the applicant, I am of the view that it is a case, in which applicant may be released on bail.
Consequently, without commenting on the merits of the case, first bail application for grant of bail filed on behalf of applicant, stands allowed.

7. It is directed that applicant be released on bail on his furnishing a personal bond in the sum of Rs.50,000/- (Rupees Fifty thousand only) with one solvent surety in the like amount to the satisfaction of the trial Court, for his regular appearance before the trial Court during trial with a condition that he shall remain present before the concerned Court on all the dates fixed by it during trial.

He shall abide by all the conditions enumerated under Section 437(3) of Cr.P.C..
8.
This order shall be effective till the end of the trial.
However, in case of bail jump and breach of any of the conditions of bail, it shall become ineffective.
Certified copy as per rules.
